# Tier 1 golden cell IDs for ws-math (TP-005, ADR 0015).
#
# These values must match exactly on every platform (Linux x86-64 and
# macOS arm64 CI). Changing any of them changes which cell an entity is in,
# which breaks saves: an update needs a written justification, Product Owner
# approval, and a version bump (docs/process/testing-policy.md section 2).
#
# cell <lat_deg> <lon_deg> <leaf> <sector> <n0> <n1> <n2> <n3>
#   Leaf (level 30) and sector (level 13) cell of the latitude/longitude,
#   then the sector cell's four edge neighbours in S2 order (-j, +i, +j, -i).
#   Degrees are parsed as f64 and converted with f64::to_radians.
#
# reexpress <sector> <east> <north> <up> <result_sector>
#   SurfacePos::new(sector, [east, north, up] as f32).reexpress() lands in
#   result_sector.
#
# Provenance: produced by this implementation. Every `cell` line except the
# two cube-vertex points was independently reproduced by s2sphere 0.2.5 (a
# Python port of Google S2) using the platform math library. At the two
# cube vertices (+-35.264389682754654, 45 / -135) the platform sin() and
# libm's sin() differ by one ulp, which changes the face: exactly the
# platform dependence that ADR 0015 removes by using libm everywhere.
#
